description: Plays one specific pick through Music Assistant (Tidal) on one speaker: an artist, a song, an album or one of Ty's playlists. The voice agent's music tool (2026-11-04): the Voice: play music automation hands vague and mood requests ('good morning music', 'something chill') to Claude, which reads Ty's taste in the house wiki (Music Taste Profile) and calls this with a concrete choice. Ty's own playlists: Dinner Music, Cocktail Hour, Driving Range, Work Focus, Funky Vibes, Funky, Chill HipHop, Vibe Farming, Camping 2026, Running 2026, Claude Weekly Discovery, 3rd Annual Fall Classic, JBL 4312, Christmas, Puerto Vallartaaa, Wedding Songs. With radio on, Music Assistant keeps going with similar music after the pick. Returns whether it started and what is playing; if Tidal is already streaming on another speaker (one stream per account) it says so.

media.name: What
media.description: The artist, song title, album or playlist name, as spelled on Tidal.

artist.name: Artist
artist.description: For a song or an album: its artist. Leave empty otherwise.

speaker.name: Speaker
speaker.description: family room stereo (the default), homepod, kitchen, basement, or whole house (the kitchen Echo and the HomePod together).

radio.name: Radio
radio.description: Keep playing similar music after the pick (Music Assistant radio mode). Use it when an artist or a song is picked to set a mood.

variables.player: {{ players.get(speaker | default('family room stereo', true) | lower | trim, 'media_player.family_room_stereo') }}

result.reason: {% set ns = namespace(by='') %}{% for e in ['media_player.whole_house', 'media_player.family_room_stereo', 'media_player.homepod', 'media_player.kitchen', 'media_player.basement_stereo'] %}{% if ns.by == '' and e != player and is_state(e, 'playing') and 'tidal' in (state_attr(e, 'media_content_id') or '') %}{% set ns.by = state_attr(e, 'friendly_name') %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% if ns.by %}Tidal plays one stream at a time and the {{ ns.by }} is already playing it.{% else %}Nothing started: Music Assistant found no {{ kind }} called {{ media }}{{ ' by ' ~ by if by else '' }}. Try another spelling or a different pick.{% endif %}
